text:
marie: Quick sync 7 Slate release notes for docs site. Need one-line bullets, tiny SDK snippets (TS+Py streaming), two known issues + fixes, and an anchor to perf charts. Planning to publish Friday EOD. Can folks drop micro-edits in the PR? :pray:

alex: I added perf numbers to the draft: +28% throughput for long sequences, -5% median latency on short. Charts placed at /docs/perf and I added an anchor perf/slate-2024-06.

sam: I'll write a 1-line non-jargon blurb and add Dedicated customer note about opt-in batching.

nora: Adding minimal SDK snippets now. TS streaming example changed to async iterator; placeholder for retry note left for @tim.

tim: Confirmed TS sample; streaming uses `client.responses.stream()` and will retry once on preemption. Minimal example: `for await (const c of client.responses.stream({model:'slate-v1', input:'Summarize'})) process.stdout.write(c.text)` . Note: apps should handle partial chunks on retry.

nora: Python mirror: `for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='slate-v1', input='Summarize'): print(chunk.text, end='')` keeps it tiny.

jen: Support flagged known issue: fallback between quantized variants can cause small embedding drift (cosine changes). Workaround: pin `model_version` and disable auto-fallback for evals. I've added the ticket link and steps in the draft.

alex: Suggest a "Known issues" callout at the top with two bullets: embeddings drift + streaming retry edge-case so customers don't miss it.

marie: Good. Also add a migration note: one-sentence about model pinning with link to rollout docs. Keep all feature bullets to one sentence max.

sam: Done on the blurb; trimmed bullets to single sentences.

alex: Fixed one broken internal link in migration guide (quantized -> quantization).

nora: Pushed a tiny PR with trimmed bullets and the SDK snippets file.

deploy-bot: docs-deploy: build queued for branch release/slate 1 job queued  https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4920 :robot_face:

marie: If no objections I'll merge at 4pm PT and publish. Add a CHANGELOG.md line in the PR if you want it recorded. :shipit:
